items.question: Are your pool decks slip-resistant?
items.answer: Yes. We use textured finishes like broom, exposed aggregate, and stamped concrete for safe footing when wet.

items.question: Will the surface stay cool in summer?
items.answer: We recommend light-colored and heat-reflective finishes that noticeably reduce surface temperature on hot days.

items.question: Can you work around my existing pool?
items.answer: Yes. We design and pour decks around new and existing pools for a clean, seamless result.

items.question: Do you offer free pool deck consultations?
items.answer: Yes. We provide free on-site consultations and estimates across Central Ohio.
